messages:
monitoring-bot: :rotating_light: Alert detected — 5xx spike across inference-gateway (us-east-1) starting ~now. Error mix: 502/504/gateway timeouts. Latency p95 up from 220ms -> 1.9s.

alex: I'm on it. Pulling traces and KV/prefix cache metrics. Any customer-facing pages showing?

mira: seeing increasing prefix_cache_miss rates and a lot of prefetch coordinator errors in the runtime logs. Might be a prefetch congestion case.

jordan: oncall here, paging in. Any obvious deploys?

deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-14T03:11Z to runtime-service completed 30m ago by @mira.

alex: hmm, deploy was earlier. Metrics timeline: 5xx spike aligns with burst of prefetch requests and a subsequent rise in kv-prefetch-retry errors.

mira: logs snippet: ```
2026-03-14T03:40:12Z runtime ERROR prefetch_coordinator.go:215 failed prefetch: prefixID=usr:kv:abc status=E_CORRUPT retries=3
2026-03-14T03:40:12Z runtime WARN kv_client.go:142 got 5xx from kv-proxy: gateway timeout
2026-03-14T03:40:13Z runtime INFO cache.go:88 miss prefixID=usr:kv:abc prefetch_trigger=true
```

alex: that first E_CORRUPT line is worrying. If prefetch marks prefixes corrupted, we might trigger synchronous reads and cascade. Could explain the timeouts.

lisa: also seeing a pattern where a small subset of prefixes are hot. Prefetch tries to repopulate, but kv-proxy returns 502 on some shards. \ That causes repeated retries and backs up the in-flight queue.

samir: CS reporting errors for a handful of customers calling chunked-inference endpoints. No broad outage yet but some customer retries.

alex: mitigation plan attempt 1: temporarily disable prefix prefetching on runtime nodes to stop the cascade and let cache serve whatever is healthy. Rolling config change to 10% canary first. Who can flip the config? @mira?

mira: I can push a runtime flag: PREFETCH_ENABLED=false. Will do a 10% canary now.

mira: canary update pushed. Monitoring...

monitoring-bot: Canary deploy metrics: prefetch requests down 93% on canary, local 5xxs reduced ~60% on canary nodes. Global 5xx rate stable but beginning to trend down.

alex: good sign. If canary holds for 5m, roll to 100% and throttle prefetch TTLs. Also plan to add a short-circuit for E_CORRUPT so we don't retry aggressively.

jordan: documenting handoff: I'll stay until this is rolled and validated, then hand to night oncall at 1851242000 if stable.

mira: rolling to 100% now. PREFETCH_ENABLED=false across runtime fleet.

monitoring-bot: Global 5xx rate decreasing. Latency p95 back down to ~350ms. Gateway timeouts reduced.

samir: letting CS know: telling impacted customers we mitigated a backend cache issue, continuing to monitor, offering post-incident writeup.

lisa: follow-up root cause hypothesis: prefetch coordinator attempted aggressive linear prefetch for a set of hot prefixes after a background eviction. A subset of kv-proxy shards returned transient corruption/gateway errors which triple-retried and saturated runtime worker queues.

alex: next steps before we close: 1) run a KV integrity probe on affected shards, 2) add short-circuit on E_CORRUPT to avoid retries, 3) add backpressure on prefetch concurrency, 4) create an alert to detect prefetch retry amplification earlier.

mira: created PRs: #4123 short-circuit + #4124 backpressure. Scheduling slow rollout for tomorrow.

deploy-bot: Runbook action: prefetched-disabled rollback completed.

jordan: handoff note -> handing to night oncall @sean at 1851242000. If 5xx creeps back up, page SRE second responder + eng-runtime.

sean: acknowledged. I'll monitor dashboards and contact eng-runtime if >3% 5xx sustained for 5m.

samir: CS update: three paying customers hit with elevated errors, no data loss. We're offering a follow-up call.

alex: closing comments: mitigation worked, production is stabilizing. We'll keep the incident channel open for postmortem items. Thanks all for quick response. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Incident marked: mitigated (partial). Severity: Sev2. Owners: alex, mira. Follow-up required: yes.

mira: uploading logs and traces to the incident ticket and will attach the KV probe results once run.

alex: leaving final note: add unit tests for prefetch short-circuit logic and a synthetic workload to reproduce hot-prefix prefetch spike.

samir: I'll coordinate customer comms + postmortem write-up.

lisa: i'll take the root-cause investigation. timeline/checklist in the incident doc.
